settings.question: Where does KROZO ship?
settings.answer: We currently serve customers in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand. Available delivery options and estimates are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Is shipping complimentary?
settings.answer: Yes. Standard shipping is complimentary on every KROZO order.

settings.question: How long will delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery time depends on your destination and product. The relevant estimate is shown during checkout and in your order confirmation.

settings.question: Can I return an item?
settings.answer: You may request a return within 30 days of delivery, subject to our returns policy. Contact support with your order number for help.

settings.question: How do I choose the right product or size?
settings.answer: Check the dimensions and guidance on the product page. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering and tell us about your pet.

settings.question: Are KROZO products safe for pets?
settings.answer: Each product page includes its available material and care information. Always supervise pets during play and replace damaged items.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: When tracking is available, you will receive it by email after dispatch. You can also contact us with your order number.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Payments are encrypted and processed through Shopify-powered checkout. Available payment methods appear during checkout.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Contact us as quickly as possible. Changes cannot be guaranteed after an order enters processing.

settings.question: How do product reviews work?
settings.answer: Customers can submit honest feedback through the review area on each product page. Reviews may be moderated for spam, privacy and relevance.
